chunks: And He created the male and the female.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the creation of male and female in Surah Al-Layl?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Layl, this verse underscores the cosmic duality of creation as a testament to Allah's absolute power, contrasting the destinies of the righteous and the wicked. Shia exegesis often views this pairing not merely as biological distinction but as a fundamental structural sign (ayah) guiding humanity toward spiritual balance and recognition of the Creator's unity amidst diversity.
